trailhead.label: St. Moritz station, the board’s start

cautions: The lake has no railing: keep your dog on a short lead along the water.
Short ramps of up to 11% at the bridges.
Busy with walkers, cyclists and prams in summer: keep your dog close.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
